_comment: Illustrative Swytchcode policy set for the GitHub demo. Copy the relevant blocks into your workspace policy config, then run `swytchcode audit` to see enforcement. Each policy is evaluated per request.

policies.note: List repositories. Read-only calls carry no side effects; allow.

policies.deny_message: Pull requests may only target 'develop', never 'main'.
policies.note: The target branch is present on every create request, so this is enforced per request.
